title: Minimal sensor geometry for wave identification
question: For a fixed finite-parameter wave model on a bounded domain, determine the smallest spatial sensor configuration providing local parameter identifiability.
first_test: Prove a rank condition for one explicit sensor family.

title: Global aliasing in clipped spectral measurements
question: Classify parameter transformations that leave every clipped spectral datum unchanged on a fixed frequency grid.
first_test: Construct an equivalence group or prove injectivity modulo it.

title: Robust identifiability under sensor dropout
question: Quantify how many measurement channels may fail before a full-rank inverse problem loses stable reconstruction.
first_test: Establish worst-case singular value bounds or construct indistinguishable parameters.

title: Optimal experiment design for competing dispersion laws
question: For two given polynomial dispersion families, determine the measurement frequencies that maximize minimum model separation under bounded noise.
first_test: Prove a minimax design bound on a finite experiment set.

title: Boundary observation for fourth-order operators
question: Determine whether measurements on a proper boundary arc recover initial wave states in a fixed fourth-order evolution model.
first_test: Prove observability or construct nonobservable modes.

title: Inverse recovery of nonlinear coupling strength
question: From small-amplitude input-output data, determine whether the cubic and quintic coefficients of a dispersive PDE are separately identifiable.
first_test: Derive the first informative nonlinear response coefficients.

title: Local uniqueness versus parameter clipping
question: Determine exactly which clipping regions force a rank loss in a 31-parameter spectral observation map.
first_test: Prove piecewise rank formulas and construct full-rank subregions.

title: Noise amplification near nonidentifiable sets
question: Quantify how the reconstruction condition number diverges near an analytic rank-deficient parameter variety.
first_test: Prove an optimal Łojasiewicz-type exponent or a counterexample.

title: Reconstruction from sparse wave interferograms
question: Determine whether a complex wave field can be recovered up to global phase from a specified finite family of intensity interferograms.
first_test: Prove phase retrieval uniqueness with an explicit mask family.

title: Boundary potential recovery with eigenfunction traces
question: For a fourth-order elliptic operator, determine whether adding partial boundary eigenfunction traces resolves spectral nonuniqueness.
first_test: State sufficient trace data and prove or refute unique recovery.

title: Stable recovery of curvature regularization
question: Determine whether the regularization parameter epsilon in the GC08 curvature map is identifiable from finitely many controlled field probes.
first_test: Construct a distinguishability bound or parameter alias.

title: Control of a localized solitary wave position
question: Find a localized forcing control that steers a stable solitary wave's center while bounding radiation production.
first_test: Prove local controllability of modulation coordinates.

title: Minimum control energy for pattern stabilization
question: For a linearization around a Swift–Hohenberg stripe, derive the minimum distributed-control energy that stabilizes an unstable eigenmode.
first_test: Prove a Gramian formula and admissibility bounds.

title: Observer design for nonlinear wave modes
question: Construct a finite-dimensional estimator for a few dominant wave amplitudes using local observations of a dissipative PDE.
first_test: Prove convergence and robust error estimates.

title: Distinguishing noise from model discrepancy
question: Given two calibrated nonlinear wave models, quantify when observation residuals identify structural mismatch rather than measurement noise.
first_test: Prove a hypothesis-separation or impossibility result with explicit distributions.

title: Adaptive sensing of solitary-wave bifurcations
question: Determine whether sequentially selected sensors reduce the number of measurements needed to detect a fold in a localized solution branch.
first_test: Prove a sample-complexity bound under stated observation noise.

title: Inverse recovery from scattering phase shifts
question: Determine when a specified low-dimensional defect potential can be reconstructed from finite-frequency wave scattering phases.
first_test: Prove exact uniqueness or construct isoscattering parameters.

title: Confidence-certified physical parameter bounds
question: Develop computable confidence or feasible sets for spectral parameters using bounded deterministic measurement errors.
first_test: Prove enclosure validity and characterize nonidentifiability at the boundary.
